mara.activity: Wake, make the bed, and drink a little water before getting up.
mara.intention: Start quietly and keep the morning orderly.

mara.activity: Wash up, brush my teeth, and change into work clothes.
mara.intention: Get ready without spending attention on anything unnecessary.

mara.activity: Make coffee and have a small breakfast at the kitchen island.
mara.intention: Be fed and alert before reviewing the planting plans.

mara.activity: Review planting plans, check the presentation sequence, and answer early work messages from the office desk.
mara.intention: Sort priorities and make the key judgments defensible before leaving.

mara.activity: Gather my work materials, put on my cardigan, and leave for the studio and site visits.
mara.intention: Leave with the presentation materials in a workable order.

mara.activity: Work at the studio, attend site visits and client meetings, and refine the major presentation details.
mara.intention: Keep the plan coherent and beautiful while resolving the remaining decisions.

mara.activity: Return home, remove my shoes, place my keys in the entryway, and set my field notebook on the living room sideboard.
mara.intention: Make the transition home clear before turning toward the evening.

mara.activity: Take a brisk walk around the neighborhood before answering any further work messages.
mara.intention: Let the pressure settle before I re-enter the evening.

mara.activity: Cook a simple dinner at the range while listening to a podcast, then eat at the kitchen island.
mara.intention: Feed myself properly without extending the workday into another complicated task.

mara.activity: Wash the skillet, plate, and fork, wipe the island, and move my keys from the entryway to the kitchen island.
mara.intention: Reset the kitchen enough that tomorrow does not begin in clutter.

mara.activity: Sit in the living room with water and review only the presentation checklist, stopping when the sequence is coherent rather than reopening the whole project.
mara.intention: Make one controlled final pass without letting the deadline consume the evening.

mara.activity: Put away the laptop and take a quiet break on the sectional, leaving the presentation materials together for the morning.
mara.intention: Give my attention a clean stopping point.

mara.activity: Wash up, change into sleep clothes, and brush my teeth.
mara.intention: Shift from work mode toward sleep.

mara.activity: Read a few pages in bed with the lights low.
mara.intention: Let my mind move away from planting decisions.

mara.activity: Put the paperback book and reading glasses on the top of my nightstand, set my phone aside, and go to sleep.
mara.intention: Protect enough rest for the presentation work tomorrow.

julian.activity: Wake beside Mara, drink water, and ease into the morning without checking work messages.
julian.intention: Start slowly and give Mara space while she concentrates on work.

julian.activity: Take a hot shower, brush my teeth, and dress in work trousers, a restaurant shirt, wool socks, and kitchen clogs.
julian.intention: Wake my body up without making the morning complicated.

julian.activity: Grind coffee and make eggs with buttered toast, carrots, and fruit; carry a mug and plate to the dining table and eat quietly.
julian.intention: Have a steady, familiar breakfast before prep.

julian.activity: Clear the plate and mug to the sink, rinse them, and pack my backpack with the tablet, restaurant notebook, menu folder, and thermos.
julian.intention: Leave the kitchen workable and get out before I start inventing extra chores.

julian.activity: Take the knife roll from the lower kitchen cabinet, fill the thermos, collect my keys, backpack, and knife roll, and leave for the restaurant.
julian.intention: Arrive on time for deliveries and prep.

julian.activity: Handle restaurant prep, deliveries, ordering details, and kitchen management.
julian.intention: Keep the kitchen organized and prevent small delivery problems from becoming service problems.

julian.activity: Travel home, bring the thermos into the kitchen and set it beside the sink, then return the knife roll to the lower kitchen-cabinet shelf.
julian.intention: Put the things that belong at home back where they live.

julian.activity: Eat a small yogurt and some leftover pasta from the refrigerator, then lie down for a quiet reset without turning on the television.
julian.intention: Recover enough energy for the long evening service.

julian.activity: Brush my teeth, put on my jacket, pick up my backpack, and collect my keys from the piano shelf.
julian.intention: Get ready without disturbing Mara or overthinking the evening.

julian.activity: Leave home and travel back to the restaurant.
julian.intention: Be in place before dinner service begins.

julian.activity: Run dinner service and complete closing duties.
julian.intention: Stay precise through service and finish the kitchen safely.

julian.activity: Travel home, return the thermos beside the kitchen sink, drop my wallet and earplugs on the living-room coffee table, and take a hot shower.
julian.intention: Move straight through the familiar post-service routine.

julian.activity: Eat yogurt and a small portion of leftover pasta from the refrigerator, then brush my teeth without turning on the television.
julian.intention: Settle my stomach and finish the day with as few choices as possible.

julian.activity: Change into sleep clothes, put my phone on its charger, and get into bed beside Mara.
julian.intention: Sleep immediately and leave work messages alone.

julian.activity: Lie still and let the day go quiet.
julian.intention: Rest without television, conversation, or further planning.
